FAQs

Is Acctual really free to use?

Yes. Acctual is $0/month with no subscription or setup cost. You pay a small transaction fee only when your clients pay you: 2.7% on card payments, 1% on bank transfers. That's it.

Will my clients take an invoice from a tool they haven't used before?

Yes. Your clients never interact with Acctual. They get a branded invoice and click a payment link. More than 5,000 businesses use Acctual, and the most common client reaction is a compliment on how professional the invoice looks.

Can I brand my invoices with my logo?

Yes. Add your logo, business name and details. Acctual handles the invoice design for you. Multiple customers say the design quality is the reason their clients paid faster.

What does it cost per invoice?

There's no per-invoice charge. You pay 2.7% when a client pays by card, or 1% when they pay by bank transfer. There's no fixed per-transaction dollar charge on top of that.

Do I have to give up my current accounting software?

No. Acctual connects to QuickBooks and Xero, so your existing setup stays exactly as it is. Payments sync to your books and your accountant sees clean records without any manual work.

How quickly can I create and send an invoice?

Under a minute. Add your client's details, line items and a message. Acctual handles the formatting and design. Hit send and your client gets a professional invoice with a payment link right away.

What payment methods will my clients see?

Each invoice includes a secure payment link with credit card and bank transfer options (ACH/SEPA). Clients pick their method and you get paid the same day either way.

Can Acctual send payment reminders automatically?

Yes. Acctual sends professional reminders for overdue invoices on a schedule. You can also set up recurring invoices for repeat clients, so the follow-up happens without you thinking about it.

How many invoices can I send?

As many as you need. There's no invoice limit and no client limit.
